title: Adamas Trust 2026 Third Quarter Conference Call Scheduled for Thursday, October 29, 2026
body_markdown:
19 Oct 2026


NEW YORK, Oct. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Adamas Trust, Inc. (Nasdaq: ADAM) (the “Company”) is scheduled to report financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 after the close of market on October 28, 2026. Adamas Trust’s executive management will host a conference call and audio webcast at 9:00 a.m., Eastern Time, on Thursday, October 29, 2026. To access the conference call, please pre-register using this[link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KDY6-Kk8P8JyuvXhC1owkSsmk9GmJIKjKDlOD8Xbhb8yaYzB9mKGyzvv6mmnJUTU-ic3-BNo3Q3wEkEIMqF8E6vlbgY2ikaYjATI_u6tkfuLN-R_kzu75NTsUYrRbXWD8Y5Ky1JMjQYqghdNmeau6Upd2VwF7RGjdgLT0KsFfQ0=) . Registrants will receive confirmation with dial-in details.


A live audio webcast of the conference call can be accessed, on a listen-only basis, at the Investor Relations section of the Company's website at[www.adamasreit.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=VXeCuFjEVBu0j1LtAOtdjQkZql6P5dVJ35xNBsXtgAy1k5aP-Yoxb3qzJWcuq1ddYbSBJ8-TuRTVRJfJfs24YTBwoaI5Qx6aGjbbmR1JCN8=) or using this[link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KDY6-Kk8P8JyuvXhC1owkXQqHDoEUeLoxhR79nbzgQ2TW-KgvDPtHBGaIsMeIjxvjQz1Vhb1Y_WM-3gnXy4IvPg0iZrBA_JsnIVnTKiavSg=) . A webcast replay link of the conference call will be available on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website approximately two hours after the call and will be available for 12 months.


**About Adamas Trust**
Adamas Trust, Inc. is an internally managed real estate investment trust (“REIT”) focused on strategically deploying capital across complementary businesses to generate durable earnings and long-term value for stockholders through disciplined portfolio management and an operating platform designed to capture opportunities across real estate and capital markets.
